name: minutetrail
description: A small, local-only Chrome website time tracker

scripts.pack: npm run check && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/*.zip && zip -r -X dist/minutetrail-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.pack:crx: npm run pack && node scripts/crx.js dist/minutetrail-$npm_package_version.zip "$CRX_KEY" dist/minutetrail-$npm_package_version.crx
